+    # This is simplified; in a real app, this would use a proper ID generator/database transaction.
+    new_id = max(store._USERS.keys(), default=0) + 1
+    new_user = {"id": new_id, "name": name, "email": email}

+    return new_user

+def find_user_by_email(email: str) -> dict | None:
+    # Email lookup ignoring case
+    email_lower = email.lower()
+    for user in store._USERS.values():
+        if user["email"].lower() == email_lower:

 """Request handlers. Handlers receive untrusted params and call app.services only."""
 
 from app.services import users

+
+def handle_create_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    name = params.get("name")
+    email = params.get("email")
+
+    if not isinstance(name, str) or not isinstance(email, str):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid user"}
+
+    name = name.strip()
+    if not (1 <= len(name) <= 50):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid user"}
+
+    # Basic email validation
+    if "@" not in email or "." not in email.split("@")[-1]:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid user"}
+
+    if users.find_user_by_email(email):
+        return 409, {"error": "email already exists"}
+
+    user = users.create_user(name, email)

+from app.api.handlers import handle_create_user, handle_get_user
+
+def test_create_user_ok():
+    params = {"name": "  Bob  ", "email": "bob@example.com"}
+    code, user = handle_create_user(params)
+    assert code == 201
+    assert user["name"] == "Bob"
+    assert user["email"] == "bob@example.com"
+    assert "id" in user
+    
+    # Verify we can retrieve it
+    code_get, retrieved_user = handle_get_user({"id": str(user["id"])})
+    assert code_get == 200
+    assert retrieved_user == user
+
+def test_create_user_duplicate_email():
+    params1 = {"name": "Bob", "email": "bob@example.com"}
+    handle_create_user(params1)
+    
+    params2 = {"name": "Bob2", "email": "BOB@example.com"}
+    code, error = handle_create_user(params2)
+    assert code == 409
+    assert error == {"error": "email already exists"}
+
+def test_create_user_invalid_name():
+    # Too short
+    assert handle_create_user({"name": "", "email": "a@b.com"})[0] == 400
+    # Too long
+    assert handle_create_user({"name": "a" * 51, "email": "a@b.com"})[0] == 400
+    # Whitespace only
+    assert handle_create_user({"name": "   ", "email": "a@b.com"})[0] == 400
+
+def test_create_user_invalid_email():
+    assert handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "not-an-email"})[0] == 400
+    assert handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "bob@nodot"})[0] == 400
